# Card 379: preliminary single-reader candidate

[Catalogue](https://crypto.hcportal.eu/dashboard/cryptograms/1698) · [Picture original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5154/pc_hcp_379_pic.JPG) · [Address original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5155/pc_hcp_379_adr.JPG) · [Full evidence JSON](379.json)

**Partial research candidate; not a solved card.** One key-visible AI source reading was frozen before the first computational decode. Subsequent source review and interpretation used the same context and were nonblind. A second source reading and external confirmation are still needed.

Five selected lower rows clockwise270. Raised question-shaped/numeral-like marks are masked with unassigned role; small marked-r cap provisional. Ordinary date-like and publisher matter excluded.

The original images/crops remain private. Picture SHA256: `11bcba0d26df11c588835da5df35272e78a666db80c8092ceddb3dfb26e1a312`. Coordinates and full acquisition metadata are in the JSON. Ordinary dates, addresses and postal text are excluded without historical authentication.

## Readable fragments

These are separate editorial proposals tied to exact literal fragments. They are not a continuous translation; omitted stretches remain unresolved. Czech diacritics and question readings are editorial; a proposal does not establish the role of a question-shaped source mark.

**379-main-1**, literal `SRDECNY DI? ?A DNESNI DRAHY LISTE?`

[Srdečný dík za dnešní drahý lístek?; DI?/LISTE? require q → K, ?A requires g → Z.]

[Heartfelt thanks for today’s dear little letter?; conditional q/g choices.]

**379-main-1**, literal `VITAM`

[Vítám…; separate fragment.]

[I welcome…; separate fragment.]

**379-main-2**, literal `SVE SRDEC?O DLOUHOU, VRELOU PUSOU`

[Své srdéčko dlouhou, vřelou pusou?; ? requires q → K; joining to VITAM is editorial.]

[My sweetheart with a long, warm kiss?; ? requires q → K; joining to VITAM is editorial.]

**379-main-4**, literal `TISIC VASNIVYCH PUS POSILA TI VECNE`

[Tisíc vášnivých pus posílá ti věčně…; CH provisional.]

[A thousand passionate kisses are sent to you by your forever…; provisional CH; incomplete fragment.]

**379-main-5**, literal `TVUJ PEPOUS, ?TERY STALE VRELE V?POMINA.`

[Tvůj Pepouš, který stále vřele vzpomíná?; ?TERY requires q → K; V?POMINA requires g → Z; nickname not identified.]

[Your Pepouš, who keeps remembering you warmly?; conditional q/g choices; nickname unidentified.]
